assumptions: Environmental state, vehicle loading, disasters, buoyancy endpoints, drag, detection, and transfer behavior are simplified as stated by the source.
Regulatory recommendations are inferred from simulated positions, normalized equipment scores, area-ratio search probability, and local sensitivity rather than observed rescue trials.
models.computational_cost: The source does not report complete package versions, numerical precision, integration step, Monte Carlo count, random seeds, runtime, memory, or replay command.

details: Neutral buoyancy and seabed contact are named; surface contact, collision, terrain, sensor footprint, path overlap, and multi-vessel boundaries are incomplete.
No equilibrium analysis is used; feasibility depends on trajectory integration, ranking, search geometry, and operational stopping rules.
The source supplies a host-ship coordinate frame, vehicle table, endpoint cases, and example search geometry but not one frozen executable mission bundle.
Monte Carlo positions and local sensitivity are shown, but uncertainty is not propagated through equipment, detection, search probability, transfer, and memo claims.
